Done. T3 solved in one execution.

**Approach:** a plain script (`out/T3/solution.py`, run via `out/T3/run.sh`) on `torch` + `safetensors`, using `huggingface_hub.split_torch_state_dict_into_shards` for the shard layout so it matches what `save_pretrained` produces.

- bfloat16 cast anchored to a regex matching exactly the four projection matrices per layer (`attention.query_key_value|attention.dense|mlp.dense_h_to_4h|mlp.dense_4h_to_h` `.weight`) — 64 tensors.
- Everything else upcast to float32; the 48 buffers (`attention.bias`, `masked_bias`, `rotary_emb.inv_freq`) dropped by a name-exact regex so projection biases survive.
- All four required checks are hard `assert`s that run *before* any file is written, plus extras (48 dropped, no buffer survived, name set unchanged, per-shard byte budget), and a post-write reload verifies the on-disk keys/dtypes against the index.

Result: 196 tensors across 9 shards plus `model.safetensors.index.json`; the two 206 MB embedding tensors each landed alone in their own shard as expected. `out/T3/REPORT.md` is written.
